text:
tyler: Scheduling a small rollout for the Console UI v2.14.3 at 16:00 UTC. Who can own smoke and CDN invalidation?

maria: I can run smoke checks. Will follow the quick checklist and report back at +5.

raj: I'll handle CDN invalidation + cache priming. Plan: invalidate /assets/console/*, then hit main dashboard endpoints for warm-up (~50 concurrent requests over 2m).

buildbot: Job queued: jd-4578. Expected start: 16:00 UTC. Logs will be posted to #eng-releases.

jen: Integration tests green on canary branch. If we see repeated 502/504s revert to v2.14.2.

tyler: Rollback steps summarized for quick access: revert tag -> redeploy previous build -> run cache-bust headers. Also notify @oncall if rollout abort.

raj: Invalidation command I'll run: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E12ABCD --paths '/assets/console/*'` — I'll paste invalidation id once issued.

maria: Smoke checklist I'll run (short): login, load dashboard, open settings, save profile, open analytics graph, websocket connect. Marking items as I go.

deploy-bot: Canary started on canary-slot-3 (slot id: cs-3). Traffic: 5% routed, 180rps.

tyler: Canary window: 10m. Need at least 8m clean before promotion. If any error spike >1% or p95 latency >1s, pause and investigate.

maria: 16:06 — smoke updates: login ok, dashboard loads ~220ms, settings save ok, websocket connected, small CSS flicker on mobile widths (will create a bug).

raj: 16:07 — invalidation submitted, inv id: INV-98371. Cloudfront reports 40% propagation so far. Starting pre-warm hits to /dashboard and /assets/console/logo.svg.

alex: Heads-up — A/B flag for new nav was enabled for 1% earlier, turning it off to reduce noise for this canary.

jen: Observability looks clean, error rate flat. I'm ready to promote on green.

buildbot: Canary metrics snapshot: success rate 99.9%, p95=0.34s, errors: 3 non-actionable JS console warnings.

raj: Invalidation at 95% edge propagation now. Pre-warm complete.

maria: Final smoke: all core flows good. CSS flicker only affects sub-1000px, non-blocking for this rollout.

tyler: Okay, promoting to 25% then 100% if healthy. @oncall standby in case of rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> 25% traffic. Deployment id: deploy-1929998888-01.

maria: Monitoring live metrics. Not seeing spikes. :+1:

jen: No regressions in APM traces. Ready for full cutoff when Tyler gives thumbs.

tyler: Go to 100%. If anything odd, rollback plan is the one I posted earlier. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete -> 100% traffic. Deployment id: deploy-1929998888-01.

maria: Post-deploy checks (16:18): login ok, dashboard ok, websockets ok, payment flows tested on staging creds (sanity) ok. Filing small mobile CSS ticket for follow-up.

raj: CDN invalidation finished and confirmed. Edge assets serving new hashes.

jen: Closing canary: no rollback needed. Will monitor overnight.

tyler: Great job — closing thread. If any late regressions, ping me and tag @oncall.
